threads.body: This Redisson 4.x-specific path is not exercised by the added regression test: the two test modules run Redisson 3.0.0 and 3.17.0 (with 3.16.x as the only latest-deps target), and the 3.17+ module has no 4.x/latest dependency test configuration. The test can therefore pass through `cancel(...)` while the `completeExceptionally(CancellationException)` behavior needed for the reported 4.6.1 leak remains unverified. Please run this regression test against a 4.x/latest Redisson dependency as well.

replies.body: testLatestDeps covers this. The redisson-3.17 module has no `latestDepTestLibrary` cap, so `.github/config/latest-dep-versions.json` pins it to redisson 4.6.1 (the 3.16.8 pin belongs to the redisson-3.0 module). The `build / test-latest-deps` jobs run on every PR and passed here, so the new test already exercised the `completeExceptionally` path against 4.6.1.

threads.body:
Redisson made this switch in 3.26.0, not in 4.x -- `RedisExecutor` still calls `connectionFuture.cancel(false)` through 3.25.x and uses `completeExceptionally(new CancellationException())` from 3.26.0 onward. Worth naming the right version so nobody later reads this as dead code for the 3.x range we support.

```suggestion
      // Redisson 3.26+ cancels connection acquisition by completing the future exceptionally.
```

[General] `ContextPropagatingRFuture` in the redisson-3.0 module has the same missing wrapper-to-delegate cancellation propagation, and it's the wrapper actually in force on the versions where `connectionWriteOp` still returns `RFuture` (pre-3.16). I pinned that module to redisson 3.15.0 and ran this PR's new test: it still fails with this fix applied, and passes if the cancelled command is issued outside a span, i.e. when no wrapper gets created. Mirroring the `delegate` field, the `cancel(boolean)` override and `cancelFromDelegate()` onto `ContextPropagatingRFuture` made it pass. Could you make the same change there so the `RFuture` versions are covered too?

[Testing] This short timeout makes the `assertThat(cancelled).isNotDone()` check below racy. On a loaded CI runner more than 750ms can pass between submitting the command and reaching that assertion, and by then Redisson will have already failed the future with a timeout. The test doesn't need a short timeout since the cancellation is explicit -- I ran it both ways at 5s and it still passes with the fix and still fails without it.

```suggestion
          .setTimeout(5000)
```
